milestone_full: Layer S continues: 184 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 184/184/184 with a derived fence. Two curated arcs walk the corpus — the ticket arc (179-183, one object across a whole day) and the crossing arc (64-61-62-65-67, one border from midnight into the morning); chapter 184 closes the ticket at 23:30. Production-limit siege: 2,702 credential-stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244 at p50=8 ms. Spring Cloud edge (Eureka/Config/Gateway/OpenFeign/LoadBalancer/resilience4j), 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics (password 123) with a real drop-off funnel and reader profiles, embedded in-app handbook, contract-enforced English arm, world census with measured bigness and endless re-entry doors. D1571-D1573 closed the deployment image closure, the production npm tree, the CI AI database boundary and tracked launch paths against accidental ambient proxy routing. The gpt-6.2-sol API is closed by directive; all recent work is code-and-rules only. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1005 web + 38k AI green.
headline: 184 Hong Kong chapters in three arms · two curated arcs walkable · atlas lockstep 184/184/184 · production-limit siege: 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429, zero 5xx · Spring Cloud edge + 12 StateGraph lanes · admin funnel + password 123 · 1005 web + 38k AI green · LLM API closed.
features: D1573: tracked launch/configuration paths cannot accidentally opt into ambient proxy routing — a 245-file census, 63 mutation arms, and a fail-fast CI group before tee.
D1572/D1571/D1552: the production npm tree drops the four audited copies, the full profile builds the images it declares, and CI AI gates no longer advertise a database the AI cannot read.
D1570/D1569: the behavior funnel (view/click/search/read/save shares, weakest transition) and reader profiles reach parity on the live route, not just the demo payload.
D1568: chapter 184 — the coda: at 23:30 the ticket that carried only a time is claimed at the Central terminus; the count ripple moves every claim to 184.
D1567/D1563: two curated arcs — the ticket arc (179-183) and the crossing arc (64-67) — walkable from any chapter, server-rendered, locale-derived titles, no model or network.
D1560: world census measures the bigness from the corpus itself (chapters, arms, blocks, cards, hours, layers) and deterministic re-entry doors end the 106-chapter dead end.
D1541: siege re-measured at PRODUCTION limits — 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms; read plane 244/244, zero 5xx.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：184 章香港系列三語臂，圖譜鎖步 184/184/184，圍欄由索引推導。兩條策展弧已可走完——「票之弧」（179–183，一件東西走過一整天）與「渡之弧」（64–61–62–65–67，一道口岸由午夜走到早晨）；第 184 章在 23:30 收掉那張票。以生產級限流實測攻城：2,702 發撞庫全部 429（p50=25ms、零 5xx），讀面全程 244/244（p50=8ms）。Spring Cloud 邊緣、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 管理員行為分析（真實漏斗與讀者畫像）、嵌入式說明書、契約強制英文臂、世界普查（實測規模）與無盡再入門。D1571–D1573 補上部署映像閉包、生產 npm 樹、CI AI 資料庫邊界，以及追蹤啟動路徑不被環境代理誤明暗化。gpt-6.2-sol API 已按指令關閉，近期工作皆為純程式與規則。verify_all 全綠，web 1005＋AI 38k 全綠。
headline_zh: 184 章香港系列三語臂 · 兩條策展弧可走完 · 圖譜鎖步 184/184/184 · 生產級攻城：2,702 發撞庫全數 429、零 5xx · Spring Cloud 邊緣＋12 條 StateGraph · 管理員漏斗＋密碼 123 · 1005 web＋38k AI 全綠 · 大模型 API 已關閉。
features_zh: D1573：追蹤的啟動／設定路徑不會誤用環境代理——245 檔案普查、63 個突變臂，CI 在 tee 前以 fail-fast 群組把關。
D1572／D1571／D1552：生產 npm 樹移除四份受審核套件，完整 profile 建出它宣告的映像，CI AI 閘門不再廣告 AI 讀不到的資料庫名。
D1570／D1569：行為漏斗（view/click/search/read/save 份額、最弱轉場）與讀者畫像在 live 路徑與 demo 載荷對等。
D1568：第 184 章尾聲——23:30，那張只寫了時間的票在中環終點站被認走；計數漣漪把全系列推到 184。
D1567／D1563：兩條策展弧——票之弧（179–183）與渡之弧（64–67）——可從任一章走完，服務端渲染、標題隨語言推導、零模型零網絡。
D1560：世界普查從語料實測規模（章節、英文臂、段落、卡片、時辰、層），並以確定性再入門結束 106 章以後的死胡同。
D1541：以生產級限流重測攻城——2,702 發撞庫全數 429（p50=25ms）；讀面 244/244，零 5xx。
